title: Nex and HYBE Bring BTS to Living Rooms with Starri | BTS
paragraphs: Learn Our Mission Safety & Privacy News & Updates CommunityHelp Shop Shop Playground Games Play Pass Learn Help Shop Blog Games Nex and HYBE Bring BTS to Living Rooms with Starri | BTS November 18, 2026 Nex and HYBE Bring BTS to Living Rooms with Starri | BTS
November 18, 2026

Today we launched Starri | BTS, an all-new motion-powered rhythm game that brings BTS’ music to life through movement and album-inspired game worlds. Available exclusively on Nex Playground, the game launches with 10 BTS songs, transforming them into full-body, interactive experiences that bring the energy of the group’s music into the living room.

Following BTS’ chart-topping fifth studio album ARIRANG, Starri | BTS is the first-ever co-branded edition of Starri, Nex Playground’s most popular music game, and marks BTS’ first full, motion-based game with another brand. Built on the Starri gameplay engine, the new title invites players to physically interact with the music by following rhythm cues on screen, moving in time with each track, and mastering their timing to build higher scores.

“Starri has always been about giving people a way to experience the music they love through movement, and working with HYBE gives us an incredible opportunity to take that idea even further with one of the biggest music fandoms in the world,” said Tom Kang, President and Head of International at Nex. “Starri | BTS shows what this franchise can become — a new way for fans to experience the artists and music they love by moving, playing and competing together. BTS’ incredible global presence also makes them the perfect partner for this next chapter as Nex Playground reaches more families in North America and expands into new markets across Europe and APAC.”
Starri | BTS brings BTS’ music into motion-powered gameplay with features designed for solo play, friendly competition, and shared participation.

Together, the features are designed to recreate the shared excitement of experiencing BTS’ music alongside others while offering a distinctly interactive way to engage with the group’s discography. Beyond simply listening or watching, players become part of the experience through movement, rhythm, and friendly competition.

"BTS' music has always had a powerful ability to connect people, creating shared moments and memories for fans across generations and around the world," said HYBE. "Starri | BTS builds on that connection, bringing the group’s music into interactive gameplay that fans and families can enjoy together. We are excited to offer global audiences an innovative new way to engage with BTS' music and story."

The launch also marks a major expansion of Starri as a franchise. Originally built around the idea of making music something players physically experience, Starri lets players use natural body movements to engage with rhythm rather than relying on handheld controllers. Starri | BTS is its first dedicated artist-branded edition, creating a new model for how Nex can bring artists and music into active play.

Players can experience Starri | BTS exclusively on Nex Playground through Play Pass, the content subscription service that unlocks the full catalog of games and experiences on Nex Playground. Play Pass is sold separately and can be added at any time.

title: How To Spot Fake Nex Playground Websites and Sellers
paragraphs: Learn Our Mission Safety & Privacy News & Updates CommunityHelp Shop Shop Playground Games Play Pass Learn Help Shop Blog WHAT'S NEW How To Spot Fake Nex Playground Websites and Sellers November 19, 2026 How To Spot Fake Nex Playground Websites and Sellers
November 19, 2026
As Nex Playground becomes more popular, we are seeing more fake websites and sellers claiming to sell Playground and accessories at very low prices.
Let’s talk about it.
Keeping our community safe is important to us. We actively report fraudulent websites and sellers as we discover them—but knowing what to look out for can help you avoid scams altogether.
Here are some of the most common ways these fake listings appear, including what you need to know to shop with confidence.
What To Look Out For When Verifying the Playground Website

The most important thing to remember when trying to verify if a website claiming to be Nex Playground and sell Playground is legitimate or not, is to simply check the URL. The URL of Nex Playground will always be www.nexplayground.com
Fake Nex Playground Websites
The majority of fraudulent purchases happen through websites pretending to be our official website, typically using URLs that closely mimic ‘www.nexplayground.com’
Tip: Always navigate to www.nexplayground.com by typing it into your browser or adding it to your bookmarks.

If you’re clicking a link from an ad, email, blog, or social media post from your desktop, hover over it first to preview its actual destination. Even if the text displays ‘www.nexplayground.com,’ it may lead somewhere else entirely.
Unverified Third-Party Sellers

Fraudulent sellers don't always try to impersonate Nex Playground directly. Many operate through independent websites or storefronts that simply present themselves as another place to buy—sometimes at regular price, sometimes with steep discounts, and often using official Nex Playground images and product descriptions to appear legitimate.
Tip: Always buy from an authorized retailer. This guarantees you’ll receive a legitimate product, and your purchase will include a one-year limited warranty.
While used or open-box listings may offer lower prices, they also come with greater risk and are not covered by warranty.

Another precaution that you can take is to avoid using debit cards for purchasing, as the dispute process could take much longer with your bank and, in some cases, even fail. Using a credit card for online purchases is superior in this case.
As a whole, always be cautious of sites that don't offer common payment methods or only take crypto or wire/direct transfers.
Third-Party Sellers on Major Retailers
Third-party sellers can also appear on major retailer platforms like Walmart and Amazon. While their presence doesn’t automatically mean a listing is fraudulent, it does require a bit more attention.
Before purchasing, take a moment to verify who you’re buying from.
For example, on Walmart’s website, products sold directly by Walmart will be labeled “Sold and shipped by Walmart.com.”
Reading reviews and confirming you’re purchasing a new product can also help reduce risk.
TikTok Shop and Affiliate Sellers

Nex Playground is available through select affiliate sellers on TikTok Shop and the Shop App. While these platforms are legitimate, they can also host fraudulent sellers—and the usual precautions don't always apply.

Before purchasing on either platform, take a moment to slow down. A sense of urgency (like a flash sale or limited stock warning) is a common tactic used to rush shoppers into skipping basic due diligence.
Nex Playground is available through our official TikTok Shop. Affiliate creators may also share links to our products—these links should direct you to our official shop page.

To confirm you've landed on the right page, scroll down to the "About this shop" section. This area provides details like reviews, units sold, and follower count to help you verify you're purchasing from our official shop.

If you want to use the Shop App, we recommend only purchasing Nex Playground through our official store on the Shop App. While other vendors may carry our products, we can't guarantee their listings or provide warranty coverage for those purchases.
Before completing any purchase, take a moment to verify the vendor profile. There have been instances of storefronts using the Nex Playground name with fraudulent contact details.
Our official store will always link to nexplayground.com, and legitimate contact emails will only end in @nexplayground.com or @nex.inc.
When in doubt, skip the listing and purchase directly from our website or an authorized retailer.

Example of a potentially fraudulent listing.Additional TipsTrust your instincts. If something feels off (whether it's the price, the checkout experience, or the website itself) slow down. Scammers often create a sense of urgency to rush you past red flags. A deal that disappears in the next ten minutes probably wasn't legitimate to begin with.

Be cautious of unusual payment methods. Legitimate retailers accept common payment providers like major credit cards, PayPal, or Shop Pay. Be wary of sites that only accept cryptocurrency, wire transfers, or direct bank transfers—these methods offer little to no buyer protection.

Pay with a credit card when possible. If a purchase turns out to be fraudulent, credit cards offer significantly stronger dispute and chargeback protections than debit cards. Debit card disputes can be slow, difficult, and are more likely to fail.

A checkout that feels too easy can be a red flag. Legitimate purchases typically involve address confirmation, payment verification, and an order summary. If a site skips several of these steps, treat it as a warning sign.

Legitimate discounts will always be reflected in our official channels. If you’re unsure about a promotion, our Facebook community, along with Nex Playground’s official Instagram and TikTok channels, are the best places to confirm current offers. Promotions may vary across authorized retailers. Checking multiple trusted sellers during major sales can help you find the best legitimate deal.
What To Do if You Think You've Been Scammed

If you've already completed a purchase from a suspicious seller, contact your payment provider as soon as possible to report the transaction and explore your dispute options. Acting quickly gives you the best chance of recovering your funds.

If you've encountered a suspicious website, ad, or listing, even if you didn't complete a purchase, please email us at hello@nexplayground.com with the link and any screenshots you're able to capture. Every report helps us take action faster and protect the rest of the Playground community.
Shop Smart, Stay Safe
We know how exciting it is to find a great deal—but making sure you’re buying from a trusted source ensures your Nex Playground experience starts the right way.
If you’re ever unsure whether a listing is legitimate, or if you come across a suspicious website or seller, please contact our customer service team.

title: The Holidays Just Got Moving: Mariah Carey Joins Barbie™ Dance Party on Nex Playground
paragraphs: Learn Our Mission Safety & Privacy News & Updates CommunityHelp Shop Shop Playground Games Play Pass Learn Help Shop Blog WHAT'S NEW The Holidays Just Got Moving: Mariah Carey Joins Barbie™ Dance Party on Nex Playground November 23, 2026 The Holidays Just Got Moving: Mariah Carey Joins Barbie™ Dance Party on Nex Playground
November 23, 2026
This season, one of the biggest is turning your living room into a dance floor and getting the whole family moving together.
Everyone Knows This Holiday Song

On November 23, 2026, Mariah Carey’s iconic Christmas hit, “All I Want for Christmas Is You,” arrives in BARBIE DANCE PARTY on Nex Playground, timed with the launch of the new Mariah Carey Barbie® Doll. It’s a holiday team-up that gets the whole family off the couch and dancing together.
Parents grew up with it, kids can’t help but sing along, and now your family can dance to it, with up to 4 people, on BARBIE DANCE PARTY.

There are holiday songs, and then there’s “All I Want For Christmas Is You.” This perennial hit from Mariah kicks off the holiday season every year, and brings us all together in the most joyful way. With it now being available in Barbie Dance Party, families have the perfect reason to turn their living room into a dance floor.
What to Know
“All I Want for Christmas is You” is being added to our year-round BARBIE DANCE PARTY library on November 23, 2026. We would love to see your family’s moves. Post your photos in our community!
